# ownCloud Documentation

> Documentation for the ownCloud product family: ownCloud Infinite Scale, ownCloud
> Classic, the ownCloud web user interfaces, and the desktop and mobile sync
> clients. Every link below points at the current release of its product; earlier
> releases live under the same paths with a different version segment.
>
> **SOURCE TEMPLATE** — do not validate URLs in this file directly; the built
> output at `public/llms.txt` has all `latest` segments resolved to real version
> numbers by `antora-extensions/llms-txt.js` at build time. Edit URLs and
> descriptions here; the extension handles version resolution.
>
> **For maintainers:** This file serves AI crawlers and LLM tools only (see
> https://llmstxt.org). It has no effect on search engine indexing — that is
> governed by `sitemap.xml` and canonical link tags. Version numbers in the URLs
> below are resolved automatically at build time by
> `antora-extensions/llms-txt.js`; the source template at
> `ui/supplemental/llms.txt` uses `latest` as a placeholder. Exception: URLs
> pinned to an explicit version (e.g. a module that only exists in a prerelease)
> must be updated manually once that version reaches GA — see `AGENTS.md` for
> details.

## Overview

- [ownCloud Documentation](https://doc.owncloud.com/index.html): Entry page linking the documentation of every ownCloud product.

## Infinite Scale

- [Infinite Scale](https://doc.owncloud.com/ocis/latest/index.html): Infinite Scale is a data platform providing tools to integrate, organize, share and govern data and metadata.
- [Infinite Scale Admin Documentation](https://doc.owncloud.com/ocis/latest/admin/index.html): General topics, installation and administrative tasks for Infinite Scale.
- [Infinite Scale Developer Documentation](https://doc.owncloud.com/ocis/9.0/developer/index.html): Developer related topics for Infinite Scale.

## ownCloud Classic

- [ownCloud Classic](https://doc.owncloud.com/server/latest/index.html): Introduction to ownCloud Classic, the PHP based ownCloud server.
- [ownCloud Classic Admin Manual](https://doc.owncloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/index.html): Installing, configuring, operating and maintaining an ownCloud Classic server.
- [ownCloud Classic Developer Manual](https://doc.owncloud.com/server/latest/developer_manual/index.html): Writing apps for and integrating with ownCloud Classic.

## Web User Interfaces

- [Web User Interfaces Guide](https://doc.owncloud.com/webui/index.html): Overview of the ownCloud web user interfaces.
- [ownCloud Web](https://doc.owncloud.com/webui/owncloud_web/index.html): The ownCloud web user interface optimized for Infinite Scale.
- [Web ownCloud Classic](https://doc.owncloud.com/server/latest/classic_ui/index.html): The classic web user interface of an ownCloud Classic server.

## Desktop and Mobile Apps

- [Desktop App](https://doc.owncloud.com/desktop/latest/index.html): Synchronize your files from connected servers to your local computer.
- [Mobile App for Android](https://doc.owncloud.com/android/latest/index.html): Install, configure, use and troubleshoot the ownCloud app for Android.
- [Mobile App for iOS](https://doc.owncloud.com/ios-app/latest/index.html): Install, configure, use and troubleshoot the ownCloud app for iOS.

## Releases and Release Notes

- [Infinite Scale Releases](https://doc.owncloud.com/ocis_releases.html): Released Infinite Scale versions and their support status.
- [Infinite Scale Release Notes](https://doc.owncloud.com/ocis_release_notes.html): What changed in each Infinite Scale release.
- [ownCloud Classic Releases](https://doc.owncloud.com/server_releases.html): Released ownCloud Classic versions and their support status.
- [ownCloud Classic Release Notes](https://doc.owncloud.com/server_release_notes.html): What changed in each ownCloud Classic release.
- [App Releases](https://doc.owncloud.com/client_releases.html): Released desktop and mobile app versions.
- [Desktop App Release Notes](https://doc.owncloud.com/desktop_release_notes.html): What changed in each desktop app release.
- [iOS App Release Notes](https://doc.owncloud.com/ios_release_notes.html): What changed in each iOS app release.
- [Android App Release Notes](https://doc.owncloud.com/android_release_notes.html): What changed in each Android app release.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://doc.owncloud.com/sitemap.xml): Sitemap index linking one per-product sitemap of every page of the current release.
- [How to Contribute](https://doc.owncloud.com/how_to_contribute.html): Contributing to the ownCloud documentation.
